function productionEmptyState(){const d=deepClone(seed);for(const k of ['team','clients','leads','jobs','recurring','tasks','expenses','quotes','invoices','reviews','marketing','events','documents','activity','runs','memory','compliance'])d[k]=[];d.identity={version:1,activeOrganisationId:cloudUser?.organisation_id||null};d.memberships=[];d.organisations=[];d.relationships=[];return d}
let db=load(),current='Today',selectedDate=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),workMode='week';
function deepClone(x){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x))}
function merge(x){
 const d=deepClone(seed); if(!x||typeof x!=='object') return d;
 const result={...d,...x};
 for(const k of Object.keys(d)) if(Array.isArray(d[k])) result[k]=Array.isArray(x[k])?x[k]:d[k];
 result.meta={...(d.meta||{}),...(x.meta||{}),schema:SCHEMA_VERSION,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
 result.settings={...d.settings,...(x.settings||{})};
 result.profile={...d.profile,...(x.profile||{})};
 result.agent={...d.agent,...(x.agent||{})};
 result.research={...d.research,...(x.research||{})};
 result.identity={...d.identity,...(x.identity||{})};
 result.organisations=Array.isArray(x.organisations)?x.organisations:d.organisations;
 result.memberships=Array.isArray(x.memberships)?x.memberships:d.memberships;
 result.relationships=Array.isArray(x.relationships)?x.relationships:d.relationships;
 result.permissionPolicies={...d.permissionPolicies,...(x.permissionPolicies||{}),version:Number(x.permissionPolicies?.version||d.permissionPolicies?.version||2),policies:{...d.permissionPolicies.policies,...((x.permissionPolicies||{}).policies||{})}};
 result.approvals=Array.isArray(x.approvals)?x.approvals:[];
 result.agent={...result.agent,version:'21.0.0'};
 return result;
}
function load(){return deepClone(seed)}

// Phase 1: shared identity, organisation, role, relationship and permission context.
// This layer deliberately contains no unresolved Staff/Family business rules.
const CWJ_ROLES=Object.freeze({ADMIN_OWNER:'admin_owner',STAFF_MEMBER:'staff_member',CLIENT:'client',FAMILY_MEMBER:'family_member'});
const CWJ_PERMISSION_STATES=Object.freeze({ALLOWED:'allowed',DENIED:'denied',PENDING:'pending'});
function normaliseRole(role){
 const r=String(role||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\/\s-]+/g,'_');
 if(['admin','owner','admin_owner','admin/owner'].includes(r))return CWJ_ROLES.ADMIN_OWNER;
 if(['staff','team_member','staff_member','staff_team_member','team member'].includes(r))return CWJ_ROLES.STAFF_MEMBER;
 if(['client'].includes(r))return CWJ_ROLES.CLIENT;
 if(['family','family_member','family/client'].includes(r))return CWJ_ROLES.FAMILY_MEMBER;
 return null;
}
function currentOrganisation(){
 const id=cloudUser?.organisation_id||db.identity?.activeOrganisationId;
 return (db.organisations||[]).find(o=>String(o.id)===String(id))||null;
}
function currentMembership(){
 const org=currentOrganisation();
 if(!org)return null;
 const userId=cloudUser?.id||cloudUser?.user_id||null;
 const found=(db.memberships||[]).find(m=>String(m.organisationId)===String(org.id)&&String(m.userId)===String(userId)&&m.status!=='disabled');
 if(found)return found;
 if(cloudUser?.organisation_id&&String(cloudUser.organisation_id)===String(org.id)&&cloudUser.role)return {organisationId:org.id,userId:cloudUser.id,role:cloudUser.role,status:'active'};
 return null;
}
function currentRole(){return cloudUser?normaliseRole(cloudUser.role)||normaliseRole(currentMembership()?.role)||null:null}
function currentAccessContext(){
 const org=currentOrganisation(), membership=currentMembership(), role=currentRole();
 const userId=cloudUser?.id||cloudUser?.user_id||membership?.userId||null;
 const relationships=(db.relationships||[]).filter(r=>String(r.userId)===String(userId)&&String(r.organisationId)===String(org?.id));
 return {userId,organisationId:org?.id||null,organisation:org,membership,role,relationships};
}
function isAdminOwner(){const ctx=currentAccessContext();return !!ctx.organisationId&&!!ctx.membership&&ctx.membership.status!=='disabled'&&ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.ADMIN_OWNER}
function relationshipAllows(resourceType,resourceId){
 const ctx=currentAccessContext();
 if(ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.ADMIN_OWNER)return true;
 return ctx.relationships.some(r=>String(r.resourceType)===String(resourceType)&&String(r.resourceId)===String(resourceId)&&r.status!=='revoked');
}
function roleAllows(action){
 const ctx=currentAccessContext();
 if(!ctx.role)return false;
 const caps=db.permissionPolicies?.policies?.[ctx.role]?.capabilities||[];
 return caps.includes('*')||caps.includes(String(action));
}
function permissionState(action,resourceType,resourceId){
 const ctx=currentAccessContext();
 if(!ctx.role||!ctx.organisationId||!ctx.membership)return CWJ_PERMISSION_STATES.DENIED;
 if(!roleAllows(action))return CWJ_PERMISSION_STATES.DENIED;
 if(ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.ADMIN_OWNER)return CWJ_PERMISSION_STATES.ALLOWED;
 // Confirmed role permission exists, but record/relationship access remains pending where the blueprint leaves the exact relationship rule open.
 if(!resourceType||resourceId==null)return CWJ_PERMISSION_STATES.PENDING;
 return relationshipAllows(resourceType,resourceId)?CWJ_PERMISSION_STATES.PENDING:CWJ_PERMISSION_STATES.DENIED;
}
function can(action,resourceType,resourceId){return permissionState(action,resourceType,resourceId)===CWJ_PERMISSION_STATES.ALLOWED}
function requireAdminOwner(action){
 if(can(action))return true;
 toast('This Admin / Owner function is not available for the current account.');
 return false;
}
function accessBoundary(){
 const ctx=currentAccessContext();
 if(ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.ADMIN_OWNER)return '';
 const label=ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.STAFF_MEMBER?'Staff / Team Member':ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.CLIENT?'Client':ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.FAMILY_MEMBER?'Family Member':'unrecognised role';
 return `<div class="card"><div class="sectionlabel">Secure access</div><h2>Access foundation active</h2><p class="muted">Signed in as ${esc(label)}. The Admin / Owner workspace is restricted to Admin / Owner accounts. The dedicated ${esc(label)} experience is not part of Phase 1.</p><div class="notice">No Staff or Family/Client business permissions have been assumed or enabled yet.</div></div>`;
}
function save(){db.meta.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(db))}catch(e){toast('Storage is full — export a backup now')}try{window.CWJDB&&CWJDB.put(db)}catch{};queueCloudSync()}
function setSync(text,kind='local'){const e=document.getElementById('syncStatus');if(!e)return;e.textContent=text;e.className='sync-pill '+kind}
function renderAdminContext(){const e=document.getElementById('adminContext');if(!e)return;const ctx=currentAccessContext();const role=ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.ADMIN_OWNER?'Admin / Owner':ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.STAFF_MEMBER?'Staff / Team Member':ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.CLIENT?'Client':ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.FAMILY_MEMBER?'Family Member':'Unauthorised';const org=ctx.organisation?.name||'No organisation';e.textContent=`${role} · ${org}`;e.title=ctx.membership?`Organisation: ${org} · Membership: ${ctx.membership.status||'active'}`:`Organisation: ${org} · No active membership`;}
async function api(path,opts={}){const r=await fetch(API_BASE+path,{credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',...(cloudToken?{Authorization:'Bearer '+cloudToken}:{}),...(opts.headers||{})},...opts});let d={};try{d=await r.json()}catch{};if(!r.ok)throw Object.assign(new Error(d.error||'Request failed'),{status:r.status,data:d});return d}
async function cloudMe(){if(!cloudToken){cloudUser=null;setSync('Sign in required','warn');return null}try{const d=await api('/auth/me');if(!d?.user)throw new Error('No authenticated user');cloudUser=d.user;setSync('Cloud connected','good');return d.user}catch{cloudUser=null;cloudToken=null;try{localStorage.removeItem('cwj_access_token')}catch{}setSync('Sign in required','warn');return null}}
function openAuth(){document.getElementById('authModal').classList.add('show');document.getElementById('authError').textContent=''}
function closeAuth(){document.getElementById('authModal').classList.remove('show')}
async function loginCloud(){const email=document.getElementById('authEmail').value.trim(),password=document.getElementById('authPassword').value;if(!email||!password){document.getElementById('authError').textContent='Enter your email and password.';return}try{const d=await api('/auth/login',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({email,password})});cloudToken=d.access_token||null;try{if(cloudToken)localStorage.setItem('cwj_access_token',cloudToken)}catch{};cloudUser=null;const me=await cloudMe();if(!me)throw new Error('Active CareWithJohn account and organisation membership required.');closeAuth();setSync('Cloud connected','good');await pullCloud(true);render();toast('Secure cloud sync connected')}catch(e){document.getElementById('authError').textContent=e.message||'Sign in failed'}}
async function pullCloud(silent=false){if(!cloudUser)return;try{setSync('Syncing…','syncing');const d=await api('/state');if(d.state){db=merge(d.state);cloudVersion=Number(d.version||0);}else{db=productionEmptyState();cloudVersion=Number(d.version||0);}setSync('Cloud synced','good');if(!silent)render()}catch(e){setSync('Offline fallback','warn')}}
async function syncCloud(){if(!cloudUser||cloudBusy)return;cloudBusy=true;try{setSync('Saving…','syncing');const d=await api('/state',{method:'PUT',body:JSON.stringify({state:db,expectedVersion:cloudVersion})});cloudVersion=Number(d.version||cloudVersion+1);setSync('Cloud synced','good')}catch(e){if(e.status===409){await pullCloud(true);toast('Cloud changed elsewhere; local changes were not overwritten')}else setSync('Offline fallback','warn')}finally{cloudBusy=false}}
function queueCloudSync(){clearTimeout(cloudTimer);if(cloudUser)cloudTimer=setTimeout(syncCloud,500)}
async function cloudLogout(){try{await api('/auth/logout',{method:'POST'})}catch{}cloudUser=null;cloudToken=null;try{localStorage.removeItem('cwj_access_token')}catch{};setSync('Sign in required','warn');document.getElementById('view').innerHTML='<div class="card" style="max-width:620px;margin:48px auto;padding:28px;text-align:center"><div class="sectionlabel">CAREWITHJOHN SECURE ACCESS</div><h2>Sign in required</h2><p class="muted">A valid Supabase Auth session and active CareWithJohn organisation membership are required to access the application.</p><button class="btn primary" style="width:100%" onclick="openAuth()">Sign in</button></div>';openAuth();}
function cloudAccess(){if(cloudUser)cloudLogout();else openAuth()}
function money(x){return '£'+Number(x||0).toFixed(2)}
function esc(x){return String(x??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function toast(t){const e=document.getElementById('toast');e.textContent=t;e.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(window.__toast);window.__toast=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove('show'),2300)}
function showPage(p){if(!isAdminOwner()){toast('Admin / Owner workspace is restricted to Admin / Owner accounts.');return;}current=p;document.getElementById('title').textContent=({People:'People',Care:'Care',Rota:'Rota'}[p]||p);render();document.querySelectorAll('.sidenav button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.page===p));document.querySelectorAll('#bottom button').forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle('active',MAIN[i]===p))}
function nav(){document.getElementById('sidenav').innerHTML=[...MAIN,...MORE].map((p,i)=>`<button data-page="${p}" onclick="showPage('${p}')">${['⌂','▣','◉','£','✦','★','◇','♥','✓','♟','▤','☰'][i]||'•'} &nbsp;${p}</button>`).join('')}

const FILE_DB='cwj_files_v1';
function openFileDb(){
 return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const r=indexedDB.open(FILE_DB,1);
  r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!r.result.objectStoreNames.contains('files'))r.result.createObjectStore('files',{keyPath:'id'})};
  r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result); r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)
 })
}
async function putFileRecord(rec){const dbx=await openFileDb();return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=dbx.transaction('files','readwrite');tx.objectStore('files').put(rec);tx.oncomplete=()=>res();tx.onerror=()=>rej(tx.error)})}
async function getFileRecord(id){const dbx=await openFileDb();return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=dbx.transaction('files');const q=tx.objectStore('files').get(id);q.onsuccess=()=>res(q.result);q.onerror=()=>rej(q.error)})}
async function deleteFileRecord(id){const dbx=await openFileDb();return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=dbx.transaction('files','readwrite');tx.objectStore('files').delete(id);tx.oncomplete=()=>res();tx.onerror=()=>rej(tx.error)})}
async function hydrateDocuments(){if(!db.documents?.length)return;const out=[];for(const d of db.documents){try{const f=await getFileRecord(d.id);out.push(f?{...d}:d)}catch{out.push(d)}}db.documents=out}

// Offline-first persistence: localStorage is the synchronous source for rendering; IndexedDB keeps a durable larger copy.
window.CWJDB=(function(){
 const DB='cwj_os_v15',STORE='state';
 function open(){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const r=indexedDB.open(DB,1);r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!r.result.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE))r.result.createObjectStore(STORE,{keyPath:'id'});};r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)})}
 async function put(state){try{const d=await open();return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const tx=d.transaction(STORE,'readwrite');tx.objectStore(STORE).put({id:'main',state,at:Date.now()});tx.oncomplete=res;tx.onerror=()=>rej(tx.error)})}catch{}}
 async function get(){try{const d=await open();return await new Promise((res,rej)=>{const q=d.transaction(STORE).objectStore(STORE).get('main');q.onsuccess=()=>res(q.result?.state||null);q.onerror=()=>rej(q.error)})}catch{return null}}
 return {put,get};
})();
CWJDB.get().then(s=>{if(s&&s.meta&&Number(s.meta.schema)>=SCHEMA_VERSION && !localStorage.getItem(KEY)){db=merge(s);localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(db))}}).catch(()=>{});
function todayISO(){return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}
function weekStart(dstr){const d=new Date(dstr+'T12:00:00');const day=d.getDay();const diff=day===0?-6:1-day;d.setDate(d.getDate()+diff);d.setHours(0,0,0,0);return d}
function weekEnd(dstr){const d=weekStart(dstr);d.setDate(d.getDate()+6);return d}
function inWeek(date,dstr){const d=new Date(date+'T12:00:00'),s=weekStart(dstr),e=weekEnd(dstr);return d>=s&&d<=e}
function weeklyIncome(dstr=selectedDate){return projectedJobsForWeek(dstr).filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled').reduce((s,j)=>s+Number(j.income||0),0)}
function weeklyExpenses(dstr=selectedDate){const s=weekStart(dstr),e=weekEnd(dstr);return db.expenses.reduce((sum,x)=>{const d=new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00');return d>=s&&d<=e?sum+Number(x.amount||0):sum},0)}
function openLeadCount(){return db.leads.filter(x=>!['won','lost'].includes(String(x.status).toLowerCase())).length}
function completedIncome(){return db.jobs.filter(j=>['booked','completed','planned'].includes(String(j.status).toLowerCase())).reduce((s,j)=>s+Number(j.income||0),0)}
function logActivity(title,detail){db.activity.unshift({id:'a_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7),title,detail,time:new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB')});db.activity=db.activity.slice(0,200)}
function render(){
 if(window.__cjBusy)return;
 renderAdminContext();
 const c=document.getElementById('view');
 if(!isAdminOwner()){c.innerHTML=accessBoundary();return;}
 if(current==='Today')today(c);else if(current==='Command Centre')commandCentre(c);else if(current==='Work')work(c);else if(current==='People')clients(c);else if(current==='Care')careHub(c);else if(current==='Rota')work(c);else if(current==='Clients')clients(c);else if(current==='Money')moneyView(c);else if(current==='CJ')advisor(c);else if(current==='Enquiries')enquiries(c);else if(current==='Quotes & Invoices')billing(c);else if(current==='Brain')brain(c);else if(current==='Automations')automations(c);else if(current==='Home Help & Cleaning')cleaning(c);else if(current==='Reviews')simple(c,'reviews','Reviews',['client','status','rating']);else if(current==='Marketing')simple(c,'marketing','Marketing',['title','channel','status']);else if(current==='MoveWithJohn')move(c);else if(current==='Visit Delivery')visitDelivery(c);else if(current==='Care Inspectorate')compliance(c);else if(current==='Team')team(c);else if(current==='Documents')documents(c);else if(current==='Settings')settings(c);else if(current==='Planning')planning(c);else more(c)
}
function commandCentre(c){
 const jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled');
 const assigned=jobs.filter(j=>j.assignee||j.assignedTo).length;
 const completed=jobs.filter(j=>j.status==='completed').length;
 const exceptions=jobs.filter(j=>j.status==='exception').length;
 const unassigned=jobs.filter(j=>!(j.assignee||j.assignedTo)).length;
 const open=openLeadCount(), overdue=db.tasks.filter(x=>x.status!=='done'&&x.due&&x.due<todayISO()).length;
 const income=weeklyIncome(selectedDate), gap=Math.max(0,db.settings.mainTarget-income);
 const coverage=jobs.length?Math.round(assigned/jobs.length*100):100;
 const pending=(db.approvals||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='pending').length;
 const signals=[];
 if(unassigned)signals.push({level:'bad',title:`${unassigned} visit${unassigned===1?'':'s'} unassigned`,text:'Assign an owner before the work is due.',go:`showPage('Team')`});
 if(exceptions)signals.push({level:'bad',title:`${exceptions} visit exception${exceptions===1?'':'s'}`,text:'Review delivery exceptions before closing the day.',go:`showPage('Visit Delivery')`});
 if(overdue)signals.push({level:'warn',title:`${overdue} overdue task${overdue===1?'':'s'}`,text:'Clear the oldest operational action first.',go:`showPage('Work')`});
 if(open)signals.push({level:'warn',title:`${open} open enquiries`,text:'Protect conversion by giving every enquiry a dated next step.',go:`showPage('Enquiries')`});
 if(gap>0)signals.push({level:'warn',title:`${money(gap)} to the weekly target`,text:'Use spare capacity for revenue-producing work, not low-value admin.',go:`showPage('Marketing')`});
 if(pending)signals.push({level:'warn',title:`${pending} CJ approval${pending===1?'':'s'} waiting`,text:'Review actions before anything external is sent or changed.',go:`showPage('CJ')`});
 const top=signals.slice(0,5);
 c.innerHTML=`<div class="hero agent"><div class="eyebrow">COMMAND CENTRE</div><h1 style="color:#fff">Run the business from one screen.</h1><p class="muted">Live operational pulse across work, team, money, enquiries and CJ actions.</p><div class="hero-actions"><button class="btn" onclick="showPage('CJ')">✦ Ask CJ</button><button class="btn" onclick="showPage('Work')">Open rota</button></div></div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">Business pulse</div><div class="grid kpis"><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Visit coverage</div><div class="value">${coverage}%</div><div class="sub">${assigned}/${jobs.length} assigned</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Completed</div><div class="value">${completed}/${jobs.length}</div><div class="sub">Current work view</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Weekly income</div><div class="value">${money(income)}</div><div class="sub">${money(gap)} to £${Number(db.settings.mainTarget).toLocaleString()}</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Open enquiries</div><div class="value">${open}</div><div class="sub">Potential work</div></div></div>
 <div class="two grid"><div><div class="sectionlabel">Needs attention</div><div class="list">${top.map(x=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(x.title)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(x.text)}</div></div><button class="btn ${x.level==='bad'?'danger':''}" onclick="${x.go}">Open</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="success">No urgent operational signals detected.</div>'}</div></div>
 <div><div class="sectionlabel">CJ control</div><div class="card"><b>${pending?'Approval required':'CJ is clear'}</b><div class="small muted" style="margin-top:5px">${pending?`${pending} action(s) are waiting for your decision.`:'No pending external actions. CJ can analyse the current business context.'}</div><button class="btn primary" style="margin-top:10px;width:100%" onclick="showPage('CJ')">Open CJ</button></div><div class="sectionlabel">Quick actions</div><div class="quickgrid"><button class="quick" onclick="openNew('leads')"><b>New enquiry</b><span>Capture it immediately</span></button><button class="quick" onclick="openNew('jobs')"><b>Add work</b><span>Put it on the rota</span></button><button class="quick" onclick="showPage('Visit Delivery')"><b>Deliver visits</b><span>Check in / complete</span></button><button class="quick" onclick="showPage('Money')"><b>Check money</b><span>Income and target</span></button></div></div></div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">Operational rule</div><div class="notice"><b>One source of truth:</b> a visit should have a client, service, time, location, assignee, price/cost and delivery status. If any of those are missing, Command Centre surfaces it instead of hiding the gap.</div>`;
}
function today(c){
 const income=weeklyIncome(selectedDate),expenses=weeklyExpenses(selectedDate),net=income-expenses,open=openLeadCount(),tasks=db.tasks.filter(x=>x.status!=='done'),overdue=tasks.filter(x=>x.due && x.due<todayISO()).length,gap=Math.max(0,db.settings.mainTarget-income);
 const next=[...db.jobs].filter(j=>j.date>=todayISO()).sort((a,b)=>(a.date+a.time).localeCompare(b.date+b.time)).slice(0,5);
 const cycle=db.agent.lastCycle;
 c.innerHTML=`<div class="hero"><img class="hero-logo" src="data:image/png;base64,
